- [TableOfContents · An index that follows the reading](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-tableofcontents-an-index-that-follows-the-reading.md): It marks the section in view by itself — pass current only when something else owns that state. Sub-items are one level deep and no more: an index that needs three levels is a document that needs splitting.
- [Tabs · Two readings of the same thing](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-tabs-two-readings-of-the-same-thing.md): Tabs are for alternative views of one subject, never for steps — a step has an order and a tab does not. If the user must visit all of them, it was a form, not a tab set.
- [Tabs · A column of sections beside the content](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-tabs-a-column-of-sections-beside-the-content.md): `orientation="vertical"` when the labels are words rather than one-word nouns, or when there are more of them than a row can hold without scrolling. The root becomes a grid and not a row: on a row the panel and the list share a line, and a tall panel would stretch the label column with it.
- [Tabs · When switching a tab costs a request](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-tabs-when-switching-a-tab-costs-a-request.md): With the default, the arrow key switches the panel along with focus — right when the panel is already there. When each tab fetches, that means crossing five tabs fires five requests. `activateOnFocus={false}` is the APG's manual pattern: the arrow only moves focus, and Enter or Space commits. The choice belongs to the panel's cost, not to taste.
- [Textarea · A description field that grows](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-textarea-a-description-field-that-grows.md): Rows set the starting height, not the limit. The field keeps the pill radius of every other control, because a text area is still a field — the shape changes only when it becomes a composition box with its own toolbar.
- [Timeline · What happened to this record](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-timeline-what-happened-to-this-record.md): An ordered list because the order carries meaning: a screen reader announces "item 2 of 5" and the reader knows where in the story they are. A stack of divs would say the same words and lose that.
- [Timeline · Entries that carry their own outcome](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-timeline-entries-that-carry-their-own-outcome.md): `title` takes a node, so an entry can say what it was and how it went in one line. This is the difference between a log the reader has to interpret and an audit trail they can scan.
- [Timeline · The activity panel of a detail page](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-timeline-the-activity-panel-of-a-detail-page.md): Beside the record, not under it: the timeline answers "what has been done to this" while the page answers "what is this". Putting it in a card of its own is what keeps the two questions from running together.
- [Toggle · A button that stays pressed](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-toggle-a-button-that-stays-pressed.md): Two states the user flips and reads back from the button itself. It is not a Switch: a switch applies a setting, a toggle marks the thing under the cursor.
- [ToggleGroup · The alignment row of an editor](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-togglegroup-the-alignment-row-of-an-editor.md): Arrow keys walk the group and only one alignment can be true at a time. With multiple it becomes a filter bar where none selected is legitimate — the same component, a different contract.
- [Toolbar · Formatting bar](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-toolbar-formatting-bar.md): Style and align in named groups, one tab stop for the whole bar.
- [Toolbar · Table header bar](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-toolbar-table-header-bar.md): Search on one side, actions on the other — the bar that heads a collection.
- [Toolbar · Side rail](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-toolbar-side-rail.md): A column of tools beside a canvas: up and down navigate, the separator turns with the axis.
- [Toolbar · Undo and redo](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-toolbar-undo-and-redo.md): History with the unavailable step kept in place, so the arrows never renumber the set.
- [ToolbarButton · A toggle that stays pressed](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-toolbarbutton-a-toggle-that-stays-pressed.md): `pressed` emits `aria-pressed`, so the state is announced and not only shaded. This is the whole reason a formatting bar uses ToolbarButton instead of a styled div: bold-is-on has to be a fact, not an appearance.
- [ToolbarButton · An unavailable step kept in place](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-toolbarbutton-an-unavailable-step-kept-in-place.md): `disabled` on the step that cannot run — never removing it. A bar whose buttons come and go renumbers itself under the reader's hand, and the muscle memory that a toolbar exists to build never forms.
- [ToolbarButton · The one action that is not a tool](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-toolbarbutton-the-one-action-that-is-not-a-tool.md): A toolbar is mostly ghost buttons because they are peers; the moment one of them is the point of the screen it takes a tone of its own. One per bar — a bar of primaries has no primary.
- [Tooltip · Naming an icon-only control](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-tooltip-naming-an-icon-only-control.md): The IconButton already carries its accessible name; the tip is what shows that name to everyone else. Two mechanisms, one string — which is why the label and the tip must say the same thing, never two different things.
- [Tooltip · Why a control is unavailable](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-tooltip-why-a-control-is-unavailable.md): A disabled button says no and not why, and a disabled element does not receive focus — so the tip goes on a wrapper that does. Without that the explanation exists only for a mouse, which is the failure this pattern is here to avoid.
- [Tooltip · Spelling out an abbreviated column](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-tooltip-spelling-out-an-abbreviated-column.md): `side="right"` when the trigger sits in a narrow column and a tip above would cover the row being read. The header still has to make sense without the tip: P95 is the label, the tip only expands it.
- [Topbar · The bar that carries the brand and the global actions](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-topbar-the-bar-that-carries-the-brand-and-the-global-actions.md): Brand on the left, actions on the right, and nothing in between that belongs to a single page. The floating variant sits on the content; flush joins the page — pick one per application, not per screen.
- [TreeView · A source tree beside the editor](https://aureauds.dev/pattern-treeview-a-source-tree-beside-the-editor.md): Arrow keys walk it, Right opens a branch and Left closes it — the shape people already know from every file explorer. Only the branch the user is working in starts open.

## Blocks
- [Sign-in panel](https://aureauds.dev/block-sign-in-panel.md): Card with credentials, an inline error slot and one primary action. No password is ever pre-filled.
- [Settings form](https://aureauds.dev/block-settings-form.md): One column of fields, toggles grouped at the end, a single primary action and a ghost escape.
- [Members table](https://aureauds.dev/block-members-table.md): The full collection surface: filter, selection, status per row, row actions and pagination.
- [Empty project state](https://aureauds.dev/block-empty-project-state.md): First run with nothing to show: says what is missing, why, and the one action that fixes it.
- [Stats row](https://aureauds.dev/block-stats-row.md): Four numbers of equal weight above a dashboard. Trend beside the value, never a chart without a number.
- [Pricing row](https://aureauds.dev/block-pricing-row.md): Three plans side by side, the recommended one marked by a Badge — not by a bigger box.
- [Activity panel](https://aureauds.dev/block-activity-panel.md): Who did what, when — identity line, ordered history and the unread count in one surface.
- [Run session panel](https://aureauds.dev/block-run-session-panel.md): One run, end to end: what state it is in, the turns, the tool it is calling, where it resumes from, the receipt it already owns, and only the actions the run can take right now. The approval gate takes the place of the actions while a person has to decide.
- [Review compare](https://aureauds.dev/block-review-compare.md): Nothing changes until someone sees what would change: the difference, the checks that ran on it, the one decision the change can take right now, and the receipt that apply writes and rollback points back to. Additions and deletions are text, so the diff reads the same without colour.
- [Resource workbench](https://aureauds.dev/block-resource-workbench.md): Where resources come from, what is in there, what the selected one is, what is in flight right now, where it all came from, and only the actions this phase allows. The transfer says its phase and its percent in words, so the bar is never the only thing carrying the news.
- [Analytics workbench](https://aureauds.dev/block-analytics-workbench.md): The period, the filters, the segments and the export scope on one line; the number, the curve and the same curve as a table below it. The table is not a fallback and not a tab: a chart without its numbers excludes whoever cannot read the chart.
- [Transaction flow](https://aureauds.dev/block-transaction-flow.md): What is being bought, what it adds up to, which saved method pays for it, and — before anything is charged — the consequence in one sentence. Every terminal result leaves an immutable receipt with the idempotency key, so a double click has an answer. A refund points back at that receipt instead of erasing it.
- [Device control](https://aureauds.dev/block-device-control.md): One device inside its fleet: what it is, what it is reading right now — with the time and the quality of each reading — what a command would reach and what it would do, the calibration with its default and a way back, and who touched it last. Live readings can be paused, and a firmware update asks before it drops the equipment.
- [Media library](https://aureauds.dev/block-media-library.md): One selection shared by the gallery, the detail and the player — never three strings that happen to match. The resume position is a number, the optional capabilities say which ones exist, and the queue can be reordered without touching what is playing. The transport lives in the player and nowhere else.
- [Visual builder](https://aureauds.dev/block-visual-builder.md): A canvas with an ordered outline that says the same thing, so building never requires a mouse: add from the palette, move in the outline, connect in the inspector. Credentials appear as references and never as values. Undo and redo sit beside whatever the state machine actually allows right now.

## Releases
- [v0.37.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-37-0.md): Line numbers and syntax colors for CodeBlock, a brand blue as the accent text in the light theme, and a visible disabled state in seven components.
- [v0.36.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-36-0.md): A page opening for Section, a cookie notice for Banner, Chip as another name for Badge, two larger text tokens, the brand yellow as the accent text in the light theme, and fixes to DependencyGraph and Radio.
- [v0.35.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-35-0.md): A documentation layout for the AppShell, a second row of area tabs in the Header, five docs width tokens, and snapping in the editable DependencyGraph.
- [v0.34.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-34-0.md): No lines. Components no longer draw borders on web or React Native; what needed a border to stand out now gets a translucent fill.
- [v0.33.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-33-0.md): RadioGroup on the web, a three-position ThemeToggle with a system preference, Card parts, soft buttons, a blurred Header, and popups that stay above fixed headers.
- [v0.32.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-32-0.md): Twelve new components, including Slider, ListBox, DatePicker on the web and a full color family; redesigned controls and dialogs; and a 48px touch scale for React Native.
- [v0.31.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-31-0.md): Editing for the DependencyGraph - drag, align and pin nodes, undo, containers that collapse, routed edges, tree and radial layouts, and options for large graphs.
- [v0.30.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-30-0.md): Reading large graphs with the DependencyGraph - vertical layered layout, icons, badges and ports, edges that explain themselves without color, minimap, path highlight and export.
- [v0.29.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-29-0.md): A Card that stands out in both themes, a colored accent strip on top of cards, and a fix for dark sections inside the lory brand.
- [v0.28.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-28-0.md): Share buttons that fall back to copying the link, a phone frame for screenshots, an extra-bold weight and tabular numbers.
- [v0.27.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-27-0.md): New neutral and status colors for both themes, with separate tokens for fills and text. Also ships v0.26.0 (category badges, KPI direction) and v0.26.1.
- [v0.25.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-25-0.md): Focus is drawn as a single line instead of border plus ring, and the selected tab is finally visible against its track.
- [v0.24.1](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-24-1.md): Fixes the anchored Badge in React Native and the KPI number size on the web, and adds a CSS variable for chart text size.
- [v0.24.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-24-0.md): Comparison tables: sticky header and first column, a two-item mobile fit, a "differences only" switch, and styling for groups and best values.
- [v0.23.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-23-0.md): Topbar is renamed Header (the old name still works), with a site header that collapses into a mobile menu, and a site footer section.
- [v0.22.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-22-0.md): Layout parts for site pages (Container, Grid.Item span, Section with surface and theme). Also ships v0.21.0 and v0.20.0.
- [v0.19.1](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-19-1.md): Fixes square BottomNav indicators on Android. Also ships v0.19.0: lazy TreeView, batch Gallery, attachments and replies in chat, long conversations.
- [v0.18.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-18-0.md): Indeterminate Progress with detail and tone, named Grid minimums, NavList avatars and indicators, and a collapsible AppShell sidebar.
- [v0.17.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-17-0.md): BottomNav no longer shifts when switching tabs, is shorter with labels closer to icons, and gains the capsule and expand indicators.
- [v0.16.1](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-16-1.md): Fixes the BottomNav circle-bold indicator, which collapsed into a thin line in the browser and cut the label on the compact bar.
- [v0.16.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-16-0.md): In the light theme, emphasis text and icons move from brown to a darkened brand yellow that still meets 4.5:1 contrast.
- [v0.15.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-15-0.md): React Native gets custom icon components in every icon prop, a richer Timeline, a new FileInput, and a PhotoInput that opens the photo.
- [v0.14.1](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-14-1.md): A busy IconButton now shows only a centred spinner. Also ships v0.14.0, with new React Native props for Tabs, Combobox, NumberField and RadioGroup.
- [v0.13.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-13-0.md): New typeface and icon set. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next replaces IBM Plex, and Phosphor icons replace Carbon. Icon names change.
- [v0.12.4](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-12-4.md): React Native components running in the browser now expose their state to screen readers through aria attributes.
- [v0.12.3](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-12-3.md): Adds RadioGroup to React Native, with full-row touch targets and the indicator at the start or end of each row.
- [v0.12.2](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-12-2.md): The BottomNav is shorter on the web and in React Native, with the icon closer to its label.
- [v0.12.1](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-12-1.md): React Native fixes for bottom sheets and Grid, plus LinkButton. Also ships v0.12.0 with typed icon names, round icon buttons, ThemeToggle and text components.
- [v0.11.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-11-0.md): React Native fixes for Android (clipped button text, lists that did not scroll, sheets behind system buttons), new Badge sizes and centred Radio and Checkbox marks.
- [v0.10.1](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-10-1.md): criarGlifo can now draw stroked shapes, so line-drawn logos work in React Native without importing an SVG library.
- [v0.10.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-10-0.md): Web layout additions for Topbar, AppShell, Field and Card, a clearer current item in the Sidebar, and a fix for a stretched top bar.
- [v0.9.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-9-0.md): Layout props for the web primitives, Button, Card, Separator and Dialog. The default Dialog width changes from 560 to 448.
- [v0.8.14](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-14.md): Additive props for Badge, Cluster, Topbar and Screen, a shared disabled-opacity token, and criarGlifo for custom glyphs in React Native.
- [v0.8.13](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-13.md): The React Native Card responds to taps with onPress, and the BottomNav can size itself to its tabs with width="content".
- [v0.8.12](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-12.md): A new type scale (12 to 48). Web components return to 14 pixels, while React Native components use 16.
- [v0.8.11](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-11.md): Adds MediaEmbed, which shows a video from another site (YouTube, Vimeo) in Aurea's frame, with an optional poster that loads nothing until clicked.
- [v0.8.10](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-10.md): Select gets Aurea's own skin and floating list instead of the browser's native control. Also ships v0.8.9, with navItems on AppShell and labelWidth on Field.
- [v0.8.8](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-8.md): Web fixes for Combobox, the mobile drawer, DependencyGraph and DataGrid, React Native fixes found on Android, BottomNavProvider, and a new type scale.
- [v0.8.7](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-7.md): In React Native, the brand Card now keeps its fields, buttons and focus readable on the yellow, and menus or sheets opened from inside it no longer inherit its colors.
- [v0.8.6](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-6.md): React Native gets a yellow brand Card that requires an action, and SegmentedControl and Tabs now scroll sideways with a visible hint when the options do not fit.
- [v0.8.5](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-5.md): React Native gets Tabs, new props on Badge, Switch and NavList, and fixes for controls that VoiceOver on iPhone could not reach.
- [v0.8.4](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-4.md): In React Native, the Combobox clear button is reachable by VoiceOver on iPhone, and the arrow now opens the list.
- [v0.8.3](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-3.md): React Native fixes for brand and destructive text contrast and for Input dropping props, plus Separator, a link tone on Text and new PasswordField props.
- [v0.8.2](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-2.md): React Native gets InputGroup, InputGroupAddon and PasswordField, and Button accepts any drawing in leading and trailing.
- [v0.8.1](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-1.md): React Native fixes for NumberField focus and width, the Combobox sheet hidden behind the iOS keyboard, and hard-coded sheet heights.
- [v0.8.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-8-0.md): Five new React Native components (Combobox, SearchField, NumberField, Image and Gallery), number formatting helpers and new strings, with no new dependencies.
- [v0.7.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-7-0.md): The first release of @aurea-uds/native, with 46 React Native components, plus fixes for crashing accessibility roles and a theme switch that got out of sync on the web.
- [v0.6.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-6-0.md): Nine new web components, menus with submenus, checkboxes and radio groups, new hooks, and one breaking change: size on field components is now sm, md or lg.
- [v0.5.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-5-0.md): Brands arrive as a second axis next to the theme, starting with lory, and the sidebar now paints itself with its own tokens.
- [v0.4.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-4-0.md): BottomNav, NavList and Separator arrive, Badge is rewritten, Sidebar gains a flush variant, and Button's pressed prop is deprecated in favor of Toggle.
- [v0.3.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-3-0.md): Eleven new components, including BlockEditor, Carousel, CommandPalette and Form, server rendering for 22 markup components, a React Native token target and accessibility fixes in Field and Toggle.
- [v0.2.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-2-0.md): React Server Components support, 27 new components including a new AI and Agents category, a server-backed DataGrid, universal states and five breaking changes.
- [v0.1.0](https://aureauds.dev/release-v0-1-0.md): The first public release of Aurea UDS, published as six packages on npm.
